adjudication.rationale: The server-side input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts) only validates `guests` as `z.array(z.string().email())` and does not enforce uniqueness. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already present on the booking and blacklisted emails, but it does not deduplicate duplicates within the same `guests` array. Those duplicates can therefore flow into `guestsFullDetails` and `prisma.booking.update(... createMany: { data: guestsFullDetails })`, inserting duplicate attendee rows if the DB doesn’t prevent it. The client dialog does have a uniqueness refine, but direct API calls can bypass it, so this is a real correctness issue visible from the diff.
